notes: Repository exploration completed successfully. NVIDIA DALI is a C++/CUDA GPU-accelerated data loading library for deep learning. The build system is CMake-based with Python bindings. The project targets Linux platforms (x86_64 and aarch64) and requires CUDA toolkit. The fix.patch modifies executor and pipeline APIs to use std::string_view for efficient string handling and adds GetOperator() method. All development and CI infrastructure targets Linux, making this fully compatible with Linux x86-64 containers.
